steps.title: First strand program
steps.note: Place tubes in a cold block after each reaction.

steps.title: Ligation master mix
steps.note: Dispense is rounded to 45 uL (the components sum to 45.46). Add the adapter to each reaction individually.

steps.title: Ligation program
steps.note: Ligation can be as short as 15 min.

steps.title: USER digest
steps.note: Unusually high yields later usually mean USER was NOT forgotten; low-yield outliers may be the tube you skipped.

steps.title: KAPA Pure Beads cleanup
steps.note: Can elute overnight at 4 C if needed.

steps.title: Amplification master mix
steps.note: Master-mixed in recent batches. Add the indexing primers per well; record the plate wells used.

steps.title: Indexing PCR

steps.title: KAPA Pure Beads cleanup
steps.note: Bioanalyze a few libraries to check for adapter dimers.

xgen_v1.name: IDT xGen Hybridization and Wash v3 (multiplexed capture)
xgen_v1.description: Hybrid capture of pooled libraries. Count hybridizations (pools), not libraries. Volumes follow the lab workbook; check against the current kit insert before use.

steps.title: Blocker mix

input.name: Pooled libraries
input.note: about 1 ug per hyb, volume from QC

steps.note: Lab practice: add blockers individually if the master mix is awkward to pipette.

steps.text: Dry down to 0 uL at 60 C.
steps.note: Open question from batch 2: is a long dry-down (2 x 45 min) damaging?

steps.text: Resuspend the dried libraries in the hybridization mix and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Denature and hybridize
steps.note: Record the time the plate goes in; this is a 16-18 h incubation.

steps.text: Aliquot Dynabeads M-270 Streptavidin.
Wash the beads 3 times: add 2 x bead volume of 1X Bead Wash Buffer, mix, spin, remove supernatant.
Resuspend in 1X Bead Wash Buffer, mix, spin, then dispense 18 uL of washed beads to each hyb at room temperature.
Bind: 1200 rpm, 23 C, 30 min.
Spin, place on magnet, remove eluate. Add stringent wash buffer, mix, spin.
Spin, place on magnet, remove eluate. Add 1X Wash Buffer 1, mix, spin.
Place on magnet, remove eluate. Add 1X Wash Buffer 2, mix, spin.
Spin, place on magnet, remove eluate. Add water, mix, spin.

steps.title: Post-capture PCR mix

components.name: xGen Library Amplification Primer Mix (20 uM)

steps.note: Dispense onto the beads. Seal the plate well: an open lid during PCR evaporated a reaction in batch 1.

steps.title: AMPure XP cleanup
steps.note: Label tubes before transferring: a pooling mix-up happened here in batch 2.
